title: Rental Property Service Contracts Premium Rate Card
content:
Premium figures for every tier of Rental Property Service Contracts. The monthly premium is the amount for the first dwelling unit before any portfolio discount; the additional-unit premium is added each month for each dwelling unit beyond the first; the pay-in-full discount is the discount when the term premium is paid in full up front, stated as a decimal fraction of twelve monthly installments.

## Monthly premium and pay-in-full discount

| Tier | Monthly premium, first dwelling unit | Monthly premium for each additional dwelling unit | Pay-in-full discount rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | $42.99 | $0.00 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | $47.99 | $0.00 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | $64.99 | $0.00 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | $76.99 | $0.00 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | $69.99 | $39.99 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | $82.99 | $46.99 | 0.10 |

## Portfolio discount bands

The band minimums count the landlord's rental property contracts in force at term start; each band rate is a decimal fraction of the installment.

| Tier | Mid band: minimum contracts | Mid band rate | High band: minimum contracts | High band rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | 3 | 0.05 | 10 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | 3 | 0.05 | 10 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | 3 | 0.05 | 10 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | 3 | 0.05 | 10 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | 3 | 0.05 | 10 | 0.10 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | 3 | 0.05 | 10 | 0.10 |

## Reading the card (hypothetical buildings)

- A single-unit townhome on Bridgewell Rental Combo carries a monthly premium of $64.99; the single-unit tiers add nothing for further units because they cover one dwelling unit.
- A three-unit building on Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo carries $69.99 for the first unit and $39.99 for each of the two further units, $149.97 a month before any portfolio discount.
- The same three-unit building on Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus carries $82.99 and two times $46.99, $176.97 a month before any portfolio discount.
